controls.text: Can’t Lie: Willpower Trait Roll when a lie is told in front of you

controls.value: Physically unable to lie; must correct a known lie told in your presence unless you pass a Willpower roll (TN 20).

controls.text: Contrary: Willpower Trait Roll when a dispute is going on

controls.value: Compelled to argue your view in disputes; must pass a Willpower roll to hold back. Imperial/courtier pay 4.

controls.text: Rumormonger: Willpower Trait Roll to keep a rumor to yourself

controls.value: Compulsive gossip; resisting spreading a rumor needs a Willpower roll scaled to the subject’s Glory. Courtier pay 5.

controls.text: Soft-Hearted: Willpower Trait Roll to kill

controls.value: Killing another person requires a Willpower roll (TN 20); after a kill, all TNs +10 for a day. Phoenix pay 3.

controls.text: Lost Love: spend a Void Point to set the memory aside

controls.value: Reminders of a lost love raise all your TNs by 5 until you spend a Void Point to refocus (max twice/day).
